name: pr-review-agent-web
description: Web dashboard for pr-review-agent — thin API + React SPA that reuses mcp-server/src.

scripts.web:dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.web:build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.web:typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
